tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background: the map table everything sits on.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, door cards, sheets and menus.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, input borders, map grid.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, on surface and surface-raised (16:1 and up in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, addresses under owner names; on surface and surface-raised (5.5:1 light, 7:1 dark).

tokens.name: deep
tokens.usage: Benchmark navy: brand blocks, the parent app icon, the website header band. Flips to pale in dark so it never sinks into the dark ground.

tokens.name: on-deep
tokens.usage: Text and the reverse mark on a deep fill.

tokens.name: flag
tokens.usage: Flagging-tape orange: the one action colour (primary buttons, the closing station, focus ring). As text on surface: 5.4:1 light, 8:1 dark.

tokens.name: on-flag
tokens.usage: Labels on a flag fill (4.6:1 light, 7.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: flag-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind flag text: selected rows, the active map pin halo.

tokens.name: solar
tokens.usage: TraverseSolar edition fill: its icon tile, header accent, map pins. Never as text on surface (1.9:1); pair with on-solar.

tokens.name: on-solar
tokens.usage: Text and mark on a solar fill (8.6:1).

tokens.name: roof
tokens.usage: TraverseRoofing edition fill. White on it: 5.9:1.

tokens.name: on-roof
tokens.usage: Text and mark on a roof fill.

tokens.name: pest
tokens.usage: TraversePest edition fill. White on it: 6.9:1. Low against the dark ground (2.7:1): tiles carry a label.

tokens.name: on-pest
tokens.usage: Text and mark on a pest fill.

tokens.name: yards
tokens.usage: TraverseYards (landscaping and lawn) edition fill. White on it: 5.3:1.

tokens.name: on-yards
tokens.usage: Text and mark on a yards fill.

tokens.name: security
tokens.usage: TraverseSecurity edition fill (night teal). White on it: 5.8:1. Low against the dark ground (3.0:1): tiles carry a label.

tokens.name: on-security
tokens.usage: Text and mark on a security fill.

tokens.name: won
tokens.usage: Pipeline state Won, as chip text and dot; always with the word.

tokens.name: won-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind won text.

tokens.name: lost
tokens.usage: Pipeline state Lost and destructive actions; always with the word. Darker than won in light, lighter in dark, so the two differ by more than hue.

tokens.name: lost-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind lost text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: a 2px solid flag ring, 2px off the element (4.2:1 on surface).

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Familjen Grotesk (Google Fonts). The wordmark, headlines, numbers that matter. Weight 700 for the wordmark, 600 for headings.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Section openers on the website, empty states in the app.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Screen titles, the open door card's address.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Atkinson Hyperlegible (Google Fonts), drawn for legibility: reps read it in sun, in a truck, with gloves on.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Mark the door, book the walk, and the office sees it.
styles.usage: All running text, in the app and on the site.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Button labels, owner names, the one thing in a row that matters.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Owner of record · tax bill to Denver, CO
styles.usage: Metadata and captions. Never below 13px in the app.

groups.name: Data
groups.note: JetBrains Mono for station-style numbers: counts, distances, roof squares, dates in tables.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Figures in lists and tables, with tabular numerals.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips; between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between rows in a list.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; the app's side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between cards and sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Website section gutters.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Website section spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, blocks.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: App icon tiles at 64px (scale with the tile: 22% of its side).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Stage chips and map pins.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Door cards and floating sheets; never on chips or buttons.
